scope_summary.value: Electrical design for new parking lot LED lighting and 200A exterior panelboard to support new surface parking lot constructed on the footprint of demolished NIH Buildings 18, 18T, 32 & 32T. Included new gate booth power supply.
scope_summary.quote: Provide power to parking lot lights to support the new paved parking lot where NIH Buildings 18, 18T, 32 & 32T were demolished.

corroboration.claim: Provide power to parking lot lights to support the new paved parking lot where NIH Buildings 18, 18T, 32 & 32T were demolished.

Provide new parking lot LED lights in the new paved parking lot being constructed. Provide a new 200A Exterior Panelboard next to the existing Transformer "AT-3" to power the new parking lot LED lights and the new gate booth.
corroboration.value: New LED lights + 200A panelboard + gate booth power

corroboration.claim: Provide energy-efficient utilities and lighting to support safe and secure continuous use of parking lot.
